name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Live Cups for 2–8 racers with customizable presets, track drafting, live rankings and buffered spectator POV.
changelog: Fixed split-update stutters in longer Cups, improved finish delivery under high latency and packet backlogs, and fixed chat scrolling when switching lobby tabs. Removed Cup autosaves, restoration, and player-management arrows from final results.
